item.coloph: gsol 'debs byin rlabs char 'beb 'di / gyer spungs nas 'bum rjes 'od kyi bar la / bzhag nas smon pa cig gang nas yod pa de la brten nas bkod / gyer spungs yan chad ni rgyud kha gsum po bsdus zhing / ye shes skye ba tshigs gi rgyud pa'i lho rgyud la yang brten nas / ri bkra mtsho long dben gnas kyi khrod du / khrom ston pa tshe dbang rgyal po sbyar ba dge legs 'phel
item.note: this text includes a number of names of places in which the members of the lineage stayed. in the colophon, the author seems to indicate that the gsol 'debs was composed in two stages. the first stage starts with gyer-spungs snang-bzher lod-po up to dam-pa 'bum-rje (?). gyer spungs upheld the previous three lineages (probably these are the three lineages: grub thob snyan khungs rgyud pa, sems dpa' brda' rgyud, rig 'dzin rig rgyud; Íatapi†aka edition, p. 26.1, says all these teachings converged in gyer-spungs,). the second stage is the 'southern transmission of the Word transmission (lho rgyud is a lineage that started from yang-ston dam-pa 'bum-rje. it is said that after dam-pa 'bum-rje, the lineage diverged into northern transmission [byang rgyud] and southern transmission [lho rgyud]; see Íatapi†aka edition, p. 60.4).
